In information retrieval (IR), fine-tuning neural retrieval models has been effective, where an encoder learns to project each document d to a dense vector close to that of a relevant query q. For domains without (q, d) pairs available for fine-tuning, pseudo-query generation (PQG), such as GPL, has been proposed, where a pseudo-query q for d is generated using large language models (LLMs)...
